description: This file implements the SetVideoGeometry class, which is responsible for setting the video geometry in a media player context. It includes methods for construction, destruction, and execution of the task, and interacts with external components such as the player interface and the context.

classes.name: SetVideoGeometry
classes.description: A class representing a task to set the video geometry in the media player.

methods.name: SetVideoGeometry
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the task with the given context, player, and rectangle.

methods.name: ~SetVideoGeometry
methods.description: Destructor that logs the completion of the task.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the task by updating the pending geometry in the context and calling the player's method to set the rectangle if the pipeline exists.
